mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate to below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST > 660 and RSAFS > 405000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a potential supply shock or slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%) indicate a 'growth vs inflation' trade-off, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below -0.03.
